newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's Oct inflation 1.55 pct - official.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's Oct inflation 1.55 pct - official.

text.p: Ecuador's Consumer Price Index rose by 1.55 percent in October 1996, up from 1.3 percent in October 1995 and 2.38 percent in September this year, the National Statistics and Census Institute said Thursday.
Cumulative inflation for the 12 months to end of October was 25.35 percent, while cumulative inflation for the first 10 months of 1996 was 21.2 percent, up from 18.8 percent in the same period 1995.
The government expects to close 1996 with 25 percent inflation.
